verdict.summary_en: Polish delivery note (Dokument WZ) WZ-261021-680 dated 21.10.2026 from Karton Nowak, Poznań to Soony Distribution Center, Hamburg, against order 4500318731. One line: CMP-GAM-008, Art Book Grand Heist 6, 13.500 PCS (13,500), 6 packages, gross weight 66 kg, carrier PO 53225. Signed as received by hand: 'Meyer K.'. No corrections or strike-throughs. No receiving date stamp is visible.
red_flags: Gross weight of 66 kg looks implausibly low for 13.500 (13,500) hardcover 96-page art books in 6 packages. Quantity, weight and package count may not agree. Recorded as written.
The sender asks for the EUR pallets to be returned ('prosimy o zwrot').
The document has no receiving date stamp, so the date of receipt is not shown on the paper. The receiver signature 'Meyer K.' has no date next to it.
observations: Printed document with a clean scan and no stamps.
The item description is cut off at '(96 p, hard' with no closing parenthesis. It may be truncated in the table cell.
The quantity '13.500' uses the Polish thousands separator and is read as 13500.
The only handwriting is the blue-ink signature 'Meyer K.' on the 'Odebrał' line.
No quantity ordered is given on the note, so it cannot be compared with the order.
